---

## Company Overview
Gagan Engineering Works is an Indian industrial manufacturer specializing in high-precision machinery for intimate wear manufacturing (bra cup moulding machines), pre-engineered building (PEB) roll formers, hydraulic decoilers, and cut-to-length (CTL) processing lines. All machines are designed, engineered, and assembled at their Khopoli works in Maharashtra.

---

## Primary Machinery Lines

### 1. Bra Cup Moulding Machines (Lingerie & Intimate-Wear Industry)
- **Double Head Electric Bra Cup Moulding Machine**: Twin-station press enabling simultaneous moulding and loading. Features PID temperature control (0–250°C), pneumatic clamping, ~400–600 pcs/shift output, 3-Phase 415V power.
- **Bra Cup Fabric Moulding Machine**: Specialized press for laminated and woven fabrics with interchangeable aluminium moulds, 25–40s cycle time.
- **Foam Bra Cup Moulding Machine**: Hot-press moulding for PU, polyester, and memory foam sheets with uniform top/bottom platen heating.
- **Padded Bra Cup Moulding Machine**: Multi-layer composite cup forming for foam, fabric, and lining simultaneously.

### 2. Roll Forming & Pre-Engineered Building Machinery
- **10 Tons Hydraulic Decoiler**: 10,000 kg coil capacity, 480–520 mm adjustable ID mandrel, motorised rotation with pneumatic disc brake.
- **Automatic Roofing Sheet Crimping Machine**: High-speed curved profile crimping for pre-painted GI/GP/aluminium sheets up to 1250 mm width.
- **C / Z Purlin Roll Forming Machine**: Quick interchangeable C & Z section purlin line with integrated PLC + HMI, speed 10–18 m/min, thickness 1.5–3.2 mm.
- **Corrugated Sheets Making Machine**: Heavy-duty continuous corrugated profile roll former with hydraulic cut-to-length guillotine.

### 3. Cut To Length (CTL) Lines
- **Automatic Cut To Length (CTL) Machine**: 6 mm thickness capacity, 400 mm sheet width, 20 m/min line speed, 10 Ton hydraulic decoiler with sensor control, 9-roll gear-driven leveler (EN31 hardened rolls, 52–54 HRC), mechanical shear up to 6mm, touch-screen VFD PLC control.

---

## Services & Support
- **Custom Engineering**: Customized platens, roll diameters, and automation controls based on factory requirements.
- **Installation & Commissioning**: Pan-India on-site installation, operator training, 1-year warranty, and lifetime technical support.
- **Spare Parts & Tooling**: Readily available replacement rolls, PID controllers, hydraulic valves, and heating elements.
